extensionDescription.message: Turn a bookmark folder into a finite, locked reading queue: get N articles at a time, then unlock the next batch.

optionsTagline.message: Finish one batch before the next.

optionsQueueFolderDescription.message: Articles are drawn only from direct bookmarks in this folder. Subfolders are left untouched.

optionsBatchDescription.message: Choose the batch size and selection method. Size changes apply to the next batch without interrupting the current one.

optionsBatchLimitHint.message: Maximum 10 — beyond that, the queue becomes another bookmark folder.

optionsArchiveHint.message: Finished articles are moved into this subfolder under the reading folder. They are never deleted.

strategyRandomDescription.message: Pick completely at random — the easiest way to rediscover forgotten saves.

strategyOldestDescription.message: Clear the oldest saves first, including the ones waiting for years.

strategyDiversityDescription.message: Rotate across domains so one batch is not dominated by one site.

strategyBalancedDescription.message: Mix quick reads with longer articles worth settling into.

strategyAiDescription.message: Choose articles with AI based on your interests and context.

readerTagline.message: Turn bookmarks into a queue you can finish.

readerSetupText.message: Pick the bookmark folder where you keep articles to read. Each time you open this page, you will see only a small batch from it.

readerFolderMissingText.message: It may have been deleted or moved. Choose another folder to continue.

readerFolderEmptyText.message: Save a few articles you want to read. Saving stays unlimited — only the number you see at once is limited.

readerReadyText.message: $AVAILABLE$ articles are waiting. Drawing a batch will lock $SIZE$ until it is finished.

readerRerollAvailableTitle.message: You can reroll the whole batch once per day.

readerRerollStartedTitle.message: This batch has already started. You cannot reroll it, but individual articles can be abandoned.

readerRerollUsedTitle.message: Today's reroll is used. It returns tomorrow.

readerCompleteMore.message: $COUNT$ articles remain in the reading folder. Continue?

readerCompleteEmpty.message: Your reading folder is empty. Save something new when you are ready.

readerRemaining.message: $COUNT$ left. No new articles appear until this batch is complete.

toastBookmarkMissing.message: This bookmark is gone, so it was cleared from the queue.

toastArchived.message: Archived with today as the saved date.

toastLocked.message: Finish the current batch before drawing another.

toastRerollUsed.message: Today's reroll is already used. Try again tomorrow.

toastRerollStarted.message: This batch has started and cannot be rerolled. Abandon an individual article if needed.

toastFolderEmpty.message: No readable articles are waiting in this folder.

toastConflict.message: Another tab changed the queue. The page has been refreshed.

toastRerolled.message: New batch drawn. Today's reroll is now used.

articleInvalid.message: No longer in the reading folder

articleAbandonTitle.message: Permanently delete this bookmark. This cannot be undone.

arcadeReadMoreLoop.message: Read $AMOUNT$ more to start the next loop

arcadeStart.message: ▶ Finish your first article to start

milestoneOldManSea.message: The Old Man and the Sea
